summary: Verified additive changes: 7-topic content API, Opettele flashcards mode, Recognize overlay persistence, and full-pool Match batches. Backend 10/10 pytest tests pass (7 topics with correct ids/order/counts; body/clothes/nature items each carry en/fi/emoji; no mongo _id; /api/topics lightweight; per-id endpoints for new topics; 404 for unknown). Frontend Playwright: TopicMenu renders topic-body, topic-clothes, topic-nature; TaskMenu shows task-opettele first plus recognize/match/speak/write. Flashcards (body pool): counter 1/25, flashcard-prev-button disabled on first card, next-word-button label becomes 'Valmis' on last card, clicking Valmis returns to task menu (RoundComplete / play-again-button NOT shown) and star-rewards-counter stays 0 (NO stars awarded). MatchTask for body shows 'Osa 1 / 7' -> 7 batches (>2). RecognizeTask: after correct pick, recognize-correct-overlay renders and stays visible after 2.5s (no auto-dismiss); clicking the overlay background advances to next question.
critical_code_review_comments: RecognizeTask overlay uses a full-viewport click target that also captures clicks on the inner NextArrow area; NextArrow's onClick uses e.stopPropagation which is fine, but note that pressing any other key/touch elsewhere does not dismiss — intended per spec.
FlashcardsTask calls speak(item.en) on every idx change via a 350ms timeout; going back/forth quickly will queue multiple utterances (audio lib likely cancels prior). Acceptable.
MatchTask now iterates all words; last batch can be size 1 (e.g. 25 % 4 = 1) which is trivially solvable — consider merging tiny trailing batches into previous. Minor UX polish, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at /api/content now returns 7 topics in order animals,colors,numbers,foods,body,clothes,nature. Flashcards testids: flashcard-prev-button, next-word-button, audio-listen-button. RecognizeTask new testid: recognize-correct-overlay (full-screen div, click to advance; inner NextArrow uses next-word-button testid). MatchTask iterates full pool in BATCH=4 chunks.
